_doc: Task 7J section 8. Practical predicted-reference final test evaluation on the frozen final L3 test population: frozen U-C1 proposals + deterministic largest selector (no Task 7G selector), reference computed once and reused by all six checkpoints and within each pair. No seed selection, no performance gate.

resolver.label: lower confidence / larger candidate cap
resolver.mask_threshold: canonical Task 6M (Ultralytics retina mask > 0 via normalize_mask)

task6q_resolver_report.mask_threshold: canonical Task 6M (Ultralytics retina mask > 0 via normalize_mask)

resolver.note: Task 6Q's read-only `config_report()` prints the resolver module defaults (conf 0.10 / max_det 100); the Task 6U frozen `CONFIGS['U-C1']` entry used by the pipeline is conf 0.05 / max_det 300, which is what Task 7E section 14 mandates and what this run used.
